assumptions: TransTermHP's published scoring scheme (Kingsford, Ayanbule and Salzberg 2007).
limits: Two costs in the model's own scheme, both lower is stronger, and neither is a free energy.
Rho-dependent termination is a different mechanism and is not found here.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which rho-independent terminators does this bacterial sequence carry, and how good is each hairpin and tail?

description: Find rho-independent (intrinsic) transcription terminators in a bacterial sequence: a stem-loop followed by a thymine-rich tail, scored by TransTermHP's published model (Kingsford, Ayanbule & Salzberg 2007). TWO NUMBERS, BOTH LOWER IS STRONGER - how well the hairpin folds and how thymine-rich the tail is - and NEITHER IS A FREE ENERGY: they are costs in this model's own scheme and must not be compared with a promoter's ΔG or a Turner ΔG. This is the question behind a downstream gene in an operon that goes quiet: a cryptic terminator inside an insert stops transcription that was meant to continue. Rho-DEPENDENT termination needs the protein and is not a sequence motif this or any such model can see. Reports every candidate clearing the two published cutoffs; TransTermHP itself lists one per position after its own overlap filters, so it reports fewer for the same sequence - a difference in reporting, not in scoring. No confidence value is given: TransTermHP's is a lookup into a table calibrated by its own GPL tooling, which is not shipped rather than approximated.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

both_strands.description: scan the reverse strand too. On by default: a terminator on the strand you did not draw still stops transcription that runs into it.

max_results.description: how many to return, best hairpin first. Advanced.

region_end.description: 0-based inclusive end. Unset = the whole sequence. Advanced.

region_start.description: 0-based inclusive start of the region to scan. Unset = the whole sequence; pass the selection's start to scope to it. Advanced.

sequence.description: the DNA to scan - leave unset to use the open record.

name: scan_intrinsic_terminators

offset.description: where the scanned stretch starts in the sequence: add it to every position above for sequence coordinates. 0 unless a region was given

strongest.description: the best-folding candidate, or null when none cleared both cutoffs

strongestHairpin.description: that candidate's hairpin score on its own, for a threshold downstream (lower is stronger). null when none cleared both cutoffs: there is no hairpin to score, and a 0 would pass a threshold as a measured value

terminators.description: the candidates, best hairpin first, each with its stem-loop, its tail, the stem length and both scores
